name: Minamoto no Yoritada
source:
One of the Eight Guardians. 
He acts as the Seiryu of Heaven for his era's White Dragon Priestess. 
Family: Father
Occupation: Samurai for Seiwa-Genji
Innate Element: Wood
Weapon(s): Sword
Hobbies: Training (swordplay, archery, etc.)
Habit(s): Randomly hushes himself during conversations
Favorite Scent: Baika
Favorite Color: Shion (violet)
Favorite Flower(s): Japanese gentian (autumn) / Japanese pampas grass (winter)

[From [url=http://koei.wikia.com/wiki/Harukanaru_Toki_no_Naka_de_2]Koei Wiki[/url]]
